title: Wings live: Hammersmith Odeon, London | 1973
content:
Wings performed at the Hammersmith Odeon in London, England, on 25 May 1973.

It was the 12th night of the 18-date Wings 1973 UK Tour, which opened on 11 May in Bristol, and the first of three consecutive nights at the Hammersmith Odeon. The support act was Brinsley Schwarz.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.

Wings returned to the Hammersmith Odeon on 17 and 18 September 1975, 14 September 1979, and for their final live performance on 29 December 1979.
